# 03: 兑现公共 HTTP 代理和正文超时

**What to build:** 调用方显式选择直连或命名代理，获得原生 response 和真实传输/正文失败，不发生偷偷直连或预算外正文等待。

**Delivers:** P54, P55

**Blocked by:** None (can start immediately)

**Status:** ready-for-agent

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 单一公共 request 接收业务 method/headers/body/timeoutMs/proxy；默认 GET，返回原生 response，非 2xx 正常返回，传输/超时及正文读取失败分别 reject，不加业务 envelope/自动 JSON/Bearer 管理。
- [ ] proxy=false 或省略明确直连；命名项来自共享 http.proxies，支持 HTTP/HTTPS 代理连接协议；缺失/非法/不可读配置及代理连接失败绝不直连重发。
- [ ] 不依赖或修改全局代理环境，不接管宿主推理/OAuth 网络，不新增主动取消能力。
- [ ] 超时优先请求值→共享 http.defaultTimeoutMs→30000ms，须正整数，非法值和 0 拒绝；预算覆盖等待响应头及正文读取，不覆盖完整正文后的业务计算。
- [ ] 永久网络 test cases 全用 mock，验证响应、非 2xx、失败和预算语义；隔离本地目标与 HTTP/HTTPS 代理真实 smoke 验证连接协议、路由兑现及无直连重发。
- [ ] 本地延迟响应头/正文 smoke 验证正文预算、非 2xx 返回与读取失败；报告观察结果，不能以参数转发断言代替传输证明。
- [ ] 通过批准的生产公共 seam 观察行为，预期来自合同/规格、独立字面值或手算，不以被测实现重算；永久网络 tests 使用 mock。
- [ ] 使用隔离安装/配置/工作/Session/数据根，不操作正式 OMP；承接异步失败并保留够用脱敏证据，完成本票自动检查及材料准备，不因计划人工验收暂停可执行工作。

## Verification responsibility

本票负责所列 Delivers 的自动 coverage 与适用宿主贯通/证据准备；P58/P52 按本票具名责任执行。合同采用 Rapid iteration：H1/H2 及允许的条件性 H3 按原 Coverage 交用户确认，未确认不记通过；不改变承诺或免除实现/永久 tests。

tdd_result.description: Fix proxy:false bypassing ambient proxy at transport seam

data.round: retry (previous attempt's real smoke proved P54 failed: Bun 1.4.2 fetch still routes through HTTP_PROXY when a request states proxy:false)

behavior_delivered.summary: The public request's default transport is no longer the process's fetch. It is now this runtime's own node:http/node:https client over a connection the module chose: direct = the target, named proxy = that proxy's own address. HTTP targets through a proxy use the absolute request-target; HTTPS targets use a CONNECT tunnel (TLS to the target over the tunnel), and TLS to the proxy itself when the proxy address is https://. Nothing reads or writes HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY or any other ambient name; no retry, no secret direct resend. Public surface unchanged: one request(url, options) returning a native Response, non-2xx returned, transport/timeout/body-read failures rejecting separately, no envelope/auto-JSON/Bearer, no cancellation channel.
files: framework/modules/http.ts (nativeTransport + TunnelAgent + endpoint resolution + budget-bounded connection teardown and body stream; types/docs updated; fetch transport deleted)

framework/docs/framework-capabilities.md, docs/adr/0002-semantic-extension-framework.md (transport realization, response semantics, smoke coverage)

CONNECT was really implemented and exercised locally (plain and TLS proxies, TLS to the target over the tunnel, target answer read back), but not against a real provider proxy chain.
No production framework/config.yaml is committed (machine-owned); absent-file behavior is implemented and verified on both sides.
Built-in 30000ms exact value is proven only by the smoke's real 30007ms wait; the permanent case only proves no shorter deadline is imposed.
Transport speaks HTTP/1.1 (no h2 negotiation) and adds no accept-encoding / decodes nothing — documented in the module and capability docs; in-scope endpoints are not h2-only.
Proxy-url credentials are not used (config shape only has url); a proxy requiring auth surfaces as a real 407-class failure, never a silent route change.
P52/P58 remain their own tickets' responsibility; no HTTP consumer is migrated here (no production import of request exists yet).
